_meta.purpose: Groundwork for ROADMAP.md Phase 11 (loaded-dice bias measurement). Real per-face probabilities for KCD1/KCD2's loaded dice, to calibrate bias magnitudes in future simulation rather than inventing arbitrary ones. Not used by any shipped code yet.
_meta.probability_order: [face_1, face_2, face_3, face_4, face_5, face_6], each a percentage (0-100), should sum to ~100 modulo rounding in the source

confidence_levels.confirmed: Fetched directly from the item's own KCD1 wiki.gg page (per-die 'Dice Effect' table), same format/source as the KCD2 data.
confidence_levels.inferred_from_kcd2: Not independently fetched for KCD1 (wiki.gg's Cloudflare challenge blocked most individual die page requests this session). Inferred from an EXACT or near-exact name match in the KCD2 catalog (which was fully retrieved), on the strength of two confirmed cases (Biased die / Ci die) where the KCD1 wiki.gg page and the KCD2 value were byte-for-byte identical, evidence the sequel reused the predecessor's per-die data for carried-over items. Treat as a strong but not independently verified estimate for KCD1 specifically.
confidence_levels.unknown: No KCD2 name match found and KCD1 page fetch was blocked. Name confirmed to exist (wiki.gg category listing), probabilities not available this session.

sources.kcd2_full_catalog: https://kingdom-come-deliverance.fandom.com/wiki/Dice/KCD2 (fetched 2026-10-12, all 43 KCD2 dice with exact per-face percentages)

Biased die.note: Exact match to KCD2's 'Unbalanced die' -- same item, renamed.

Ci die.note: Exact match to KCD2's 'Ci die' -- same name, same data, confirms the games share this item's probabilities.

Devil's head.note: Uniform/fair -- its 'special' effect is a rule change (adds one to any combination as a joker face), not a probability bias. Inferred from KCD2's 'Devil's head die'.

Die of misfortune.note: Exact name match to a KCD2 entry of the same name.

Fer die.note: Exact name match. Part of the Lu/Ci/Fer 'demonic dice' trio (Lu-Ci-Fer), all three share this same distribution in KCD2.

Holy Trinity die.note: Exact name match. Heavily loaded toward 3s (45.4%), matching its 'especially by rolling threes' description.

Lu die.note: Exact name match. Third of the Lu/Ci/Fer trio.

Odd die.note: Exact name match. Faces 1/3/5 all 26.7%, faces 2/4/6 all 6.7% -- confirms the stated 'favour odd numbers' effect precisely.

Shrinking playing die.note: Near-exact name match to KCD2's 'Shrinking die' (dropped 'playing' from the name).

Alfonse's devil die.note: No KCD2 name match found; KCD1 page fetch blocked by Cloudflare.

Henry's Beta Die.note: No KCD2 name match found; KCD1 page fetch blocked.

Lucky playing die.note: Distinct from 'Lucky die' per an independent Reddit correlation analysis (score correlation 0.51 vs 'Lucky''s 0.27, the single highest of all KCD1 dice in that analysis) -- likely the strongest die in the game, exact probabilities not retrieved this session.

The commonest die.note: Possibly the fair/baseline die (cf. KCD2's uniformly-distributed 'Ordinary die', description 'An ordinary playing die'), but names don't match closely enough to infer with confidence.

Unpopular die.note: No clean KCD2 name match (KCD2 has a separate 'Unlucky die', not treated as the same item without confirmation).
